traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Gunnera (read 2026-10-16): rosette herbs whose leaves arise one by one (spiral, inferred); Myrothamnus has opposite leaves.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Gunnerales and Gunnera (read 2026-10-16): Gunnera (about 60 of 65 species) bear single leaves at nodes; Myrothamnus (2 species) opposite.

traits.division_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Gunnera (read 2026-10-16): large reniform leaves, lobed from the petiole top (palmate, inferred).

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, Gunnerales (read 2026-10-16): perennial herbs (Gunnera) and resurrection shrubs (Myrothamnus).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Wikipedia, Gunnera (read 2026-10-16): small dimerous flowers, radially built.
